verdicts.reason: A: the hero bottle is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail stuffed into the top-right green circle, so the product looks trivial. The body copy is small, sits on the yellow circle and is jammed against the bottom edge next to the CTA, while the oversized headline crowds everything else. B: works as a left-to-right banner, with the large bottle on the left and a clear stack on the right (brand, headline, copy, CTA) aligned on one edge. Its only flaws are minor: the decorative circles are reduced to small dots, which loses some of the original's feel, and the margins at the bottom and right are tight.
